def count_Substrings(s):
    n = len(s)
    count = 0
    i = 0
    while i < n:
        if s[i] == '1':
            j = i
            while j < n and s[j] == '1':
                j += 1
            k = j - i
            count += k * (k + 1) // 2
            i = j
        else:
            i += 1
    return count

assert count_Substrings('112112') == 6
